text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on both sides of Walker Road, between Cameron Avenue and Franklin Avenue and on both sides of Franklin Avenue, between Walker Road and a point 50 metres east. The proposed parking prohibitions on Walker Road and Franklin Avenue will allow for safe and efficient two-way traffic operation on these streets that will be reconstructed in 2018 to a width of 6.6 metres.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Walker Road, between Cameron Avenue and Franklin Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Franklin Avenue, between Walker Road and a point 50 metres east.
